title: never prepopulate password
name: Never prepopulate password
rule: Never prepopulate a password field; ask people to enter it or use biometric or keychain authentication.
pass_when: Password field is empty of a visible/pre-filled password; entry is typing or biometric/keychain.
fail_when: A password value is prepopulated in the field.
overview: Never prepopulate passwords; require typing or biometric/keychain auth.
apply_when: Password fields on login, signup, or change-password screens.
not_when: Non-password secrets that use a different secure entry pattern.
agent_hint: Leave password empty; accept typing or biometric/keychain only.
description: Never prepopulate a password field; ask people to enter it or use biometric or keychain authentication. Pass when the password field is empty of a visible or pre-filled password and entry is typing or biometric/keychain; fail when a password value is prepopulated in the field. Prefilled passwords expose secrets and bypass the intended authentication paths users should take.
